description: Multi-phase plans currently in flight. Each phase references roadmap item ids; the activePhase section breaks the current phase into concrete tasks with status. Survives conversation compactions — a fresh session can pick up by reading this file.

phases.title: Reflection over session logs: digests, delphi, user/self models

activePhase.title: Reflection over session logs: digests, delphi, user/self models
activePhase.goal: Build edict 0010 to its acceptance criteria: digests that survive cleanup, due logic, delphi with checked citations, Momus-reviewed proposals applied only by the user, user and self models with history and aspirations, Windows CI.
activePhase.sequencing: Fixtures first (real transcripts, scrubbed), then digests and due (the benchmark's baseline), then check/pending/models, then delphi, skills and CLI. Local runner waits on T-e5.

tasks.title: Real fixtures: scrubbed transcripts with rejection, interrupts, classifier denials, failures, subagent
tasks.resolution: Fixtures from real transcripts, scrubbed by tests/fixtures/reflection/scrub.py (salted hashes): Kohl's capture session (rejection, mid-reply interrupt, two pre-reply interrupts) and a window of 5e51440f (8 failures, 2 classifier denials, 5 prompt approvals, a Momus subagent), plus two synthetic events. Gap: interrupting a running tool call could not be captured (foreground sleep blocked, long commands backgrounded); its counter is left out and the digest records the gap.
